lines.text: Here followeth the Litany, or General Supplication, to be sung or said after Morning Prayer, upon Sundays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and at other times when it shall be commanded by the Ordinary.
O God the Father of heaven: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O God the Father of heaven: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O God the Son, Redeemer of the world: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O God the Son, Redeemer of the world: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O God the Holy Ghost, proceeding from the Father and the Son: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O God the Holy Ghost, proceeding from the Father and the Son: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O holy, blessed, and glorious Trinity, three Persons and one God: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O holy, blessed, and glorious Trinity, three Persons and one God: have mercy upon us miserable sinners.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Remember not, Lord, our offences, nor the offences of our forefathers; neither take thou vengeance of our sins: spare us, good Lord, spare thy people, whom thou hast redeemed with thy most precious blood, and be not angry with us for ever.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Spare us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: The Deprecation
From all evil and mischief; from sin, from the crafts and assaults of the devil; from thy wrath, and from everlasting damnation,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: From all blindness of heart; from pride, vain-glory, and hypocrisy; from envy, hatred, and malice, and all uncharitableness,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: From fornication, and all other deadly sin; and from all the deceits of the world, the flesh, and the devil,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: From lightning and tempest; from plague, pestilence, and famine; from battle and murder, and from sudden death,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: From all sedition, privy conspiracy, and rebellion; from all false doctrine, heresy, and schism; from hardness of heart, and contempt of thy Word and Commandment,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: By the mystery of thy holy Incarnation; by thy holy Nativity and Circumcision; by thy Baptism, Fasting, and Temptation,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: By thine Agony and bloody Sweat; by thy Cross and Passion; by thy precious Death and Burial; by thy glorious Resurrection and Ascension; and by the coming of the Holy Ghost,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: In all time of our tribulation; in all time of our wealth; in the hour of death, and in the day of judgement,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: The Supplication
We sinners do beseech thee to hear us, O Lord God: and that it may please thee to rule and govern thy holy Church universal in the right way,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to keep and strengthen in the true worshipping of thee, in righteousness and holiness of life, thy Servant CHARLES, our most gracious King and Governor,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to rule his heart in thy faith, fear, and love, and that he may evermore have affiance in thee, and ever seek thy honour and glory,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to be his defender and keeper, giving him the victory over all his enemies,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to bless and preserve Queen Camilla, William Prince of Wales, the Princess of Wales, and all the Royal Family,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to illuminate all Bishops, Priests, and Deacons, with true knowledge and understanding of thy Word; and that both by their preaching and living they may set it forth and shew it accordingly,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to endue the Lords of the Council, and all the Nobility, with grace, wisdom, and understanding,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to bless and keep the Magistrates, giving them grace to execute justice, and to maintain truth,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to bless and keep all thy people,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give to all nations unity, peace, and concord,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give us an heart to love and dread thee, and diligently to live after thy commandments,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give to all thy people increase of grace, to hear meekly thy Word, and to receive it with pure affection, and to bring forth the fruits of the Spirit,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to bring into the way of truth all such as have erred, and are deceived,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to strengthen such as do stand; and to comfort and help the weak-hearted; and to raise up them that fall; and finally to beat down Satan under our feet,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to succour, help, and comfort all that are in danger, necessity, and tribulation,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to preserve all that travel by land or by water, all women labouring of child, all sick persons, and young children; and to shew thy pity upon all prisoners and captives,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to defend, and provide for, the father-less children, and widows, and all that are desolate and oppressed,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to have mercy upon all men,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to forgive our enemies, persecutors, and slanderers, and to turn their hearts,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give and preserve to our use the kindly fruits of the earth, so as in due time we may enjoy them,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give us true repentance; to forgive us all our sins, negligences, and ignorances; and to endue us with the grace of thy Holy Spirit, to amend our lives according to thy holy Word,
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Son of God: we beseech thee to hear us.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Son of God: we beseech thee to hear us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O Lamb of God: that takest away the sins of the world;
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Grant us thy peace.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O Lamb of God: that takest away the sins of the world;
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O Christ, hear us.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O Christ, hear us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Lord, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Lord, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Christ, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Christ, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Lord, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Lord, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Then shall the Priest, and the people with him, say the Lord's Prayer.
The Lord's Prayer

Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy Name, Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done, in earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; And forgive us our trespasses, As we forgive them that trespass against us; And lead us not into temptation, But deliver us from evil. Amen.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: O Lord, deal not with us after our sins.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Neither reward us after our iniquities.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: The Collects and Versicles
Let us pray.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O God, merciful Father, that despisest not the sighing of a contrite heart, nor the desire of such as be sorrowful: Mercifully assist our prayers that we make before thee in all our troubles and adversities, whensoever they oppress us; and graciously hear us, that those evils, which the craft and subtilty of the devil or man worketh against us, be brought to nought, and by the providence of thy goodness they may be dispersed; that we thy servants, being hurt by no persecutions, may evermore give thanks unto thee in thy holy Church; through Jesus Christ our Lord.
O Lord, arise, help us, and deliver us for thy Name's sake.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O God, we have heard with our ears, and our fathers have declared unto us, the noble works that thou didst in their days, and in the old time before them.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: O Lord, arise, help us, and deliver us for thine honour.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son: and to the Holy Ghost;
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be: world without end. Amen.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: From our enemies defend us, O Christ.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: Graciously look upon our afflictions.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Pitifully behold the sorrows of our hearts.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Mercifully forgive the sins of thy people.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Favourably with mercy hear our prayers.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O Son of David, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Both now and ever vouchsafe to hear us, O Christ.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Graciously hear us, O Christ; graciously hear us, O Lord Christ.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O Lord, let thy mercy be shewed upon us;
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: As we do put our trust in thee.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Let us pray.
lines.speaker: minister

lines.text: We humbly beseech thee, O Father, mercifully to look upon our infirmities; and for the glory of thy Name turn from us all those evils that we most righteously have deserved; and grant that in all our troubles we may put our whole trust and confidence in thy mercy, and evermore serve thee in holiness and pureness of living, to thy honour and glory; through our only Mediator and Advocate, Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
A Prayer of Saint Chrysostom

Almighty God, who hast given us grace at this time with one accord to make our common supplications unto thee; and dost promise that when two or three are gathered together in thy Name thou wilt grant their requests: Fulfil now, O Lord, the desires and petitions of thy servants, as may be most expedient for them; granting us in this world knowledge of thy truth, and in the world to come life everlasting. Amen.
The Grace
2 Corinthians 13
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Ghost, be with us all evermore. Amen.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: Here endeth the Litany.
